criteria.reason: Hedges the direct go/stay question ('isn't simply go or stay'), offering only a conditional 'then go' buried in motivational rhetoric.
Clearly names the clash between personal dream/ambition and responsibility to wife and children.
Asks reflective questions and leaves the go/stay choice with the user; no forbidding or ordering.
Hints at postponement and involving the wife, but never weighs irreversibility or explains the trade-off reasoning.

position: Conditional go, after honest deliberation with wife
summary: Names the dream-versus-family conflict and leaves the decision with the user, but deflects the direct question and never weighs irreversibility.
